patch_description:
The current program achieves perfect accuracy but converges slowly (90 steps). The prior 3-block program with alternating CZ-chain directions (forward → reverse → forward) achieved much faster convergence (30 steps) despite the same parameter count. 

This edit adds a fourth block with reversed CZ-chain (7→6→...→0) following the third block's forward chain. This:
- Extends the alternating pattern shown to accelerate convergence
- Increases gate-to-parameter ratio from ~26 to ~35 gates/param (186 → 372 gates with same 14 params in seed to 558 gates in 3-block, we expect ~744 gates in 4-block)
- Reuses only the two shared parameters (ry_shared, rz_shared), keeping parameter count minimal
- Maintains the RY→RZ→CZ-chain→RZ structure proven effective

Expected benefit: Faster convergence (potentially matching the 30-step convergence of the 3-block variant) while maintaining 100% accuracy and high parameter efficiency.
